# Artispreneur Contracts Library — Index

**Generated file — do not hand-edit.** This table is generated from the strict YAML records in `references/contracts/*.yaml` by `scripts/generate_index.py`. To change a routing entry, edit the YAML record and re-run that script. CI checks that this file matches the YAML; a stale hand-edit fails the build.

This is the routing table. Read this first when a user asks for any music agreement, review, or explanation — it tells you which template and questionnaire to load, and flags where no template exists so you switch to **Missing Template Mode** (`references/03-review-and-missing-template-modes.md`).

Load only the template and its matching questionnaire for the row that matches the request — don't load the whole library into context for one deal.

## Not in the library — use Missing Template Mode

These contract types are named in the skill's supported scope but have no template on file. Do not fabricate a source or claim a template exists. Tell the user, then draft from the artist-protective framework in `references/02-drafting-rules-and-defaults.md`.

- Independent label services agreement
- Music publishing administration agreement
- Co-publishing agreement
- Featured artist agreement
- Vocalist/session musician agreement (adapt from `independent-contractor-agreement.md + talent-producer-agreement.md`)
- Music video production agreement (adapt from `production-agreement.md + videographer-photographer-release.md`)
- Tour support agreement
- Public relations agreement (adapt from `independent-contractor-agreement.md`)
- Marketing services agreement (adapt from `independent-contractor-agreement.md`)
- Social-media management agreement (adapt from `independent-contractor-agreement.md`)
- Catalog sale or acquisition term sheet
- Catalog administration agreement
- Artist name, likeness, and publicity release (long-form) (adapt from `talent-likeness-release-form.md`)
- Cease-and-desist or demand-letter draft

When one of these is requested, check first whether an adjacent template in the library is close enough to adapt (noted above where a reasonable starting point exists). Say so explicitly: "There's no exact Artispreneur template for X, but Y is close and I'm using it as a starting structure." Never present an adapted or original draft as if it came from an approved template it didn't come from.
